Sometimes, you know a place feels right when a child simply feels at ease!

At our very first Admissions Drive, we watched families arrive curious, hopeful, and ready to discover what learning at Airaa feels like. And while parents explored, the little ones were already finding their own way around, with curiosity in their eyes - and within moments, they were off exploring. Different corners became little worlds to discover, filled with playing, experimenting, and pure joy.

A school should be a place where children feel comfortable enough to explore and confident enough to belong. Seeing them connect with the environment while parents got to know Airaa was the highlight of our day!

Thank you to every family who spent the day with us-it was a beautiful beginning to the Airaa journey.

What does it mean to truly know a learner?

Perhaps it is noticing the little things.
The questions they ask.
The way they approach a challenge.
The confidence they find in their own voice.
And the person they slowly grow into.

Our facilitators have the privilege of witnessing this journey every day. In their reflections, they share what they see in our learners, what they value about the learning environment, and what makes Airaa a little different.💛

Because for us, education is not simply about getting children from one grade to the next.

It is about giving them the space, guidance and confidence to discover who they are and how they want to learn.

**Curious to experience this journey for your child?**

We'd love to welcome you, show you around and help you discover what makes Airaa special. Join us on our first admission drive on 26 September, 2026 between 9am- 12PM to see how the energy and environments at Airaa make a difference to your child.

Watch till the end of the video for more details. 
**Admissions are open. Get in touch with us to know more.**

From the shores of Visakhapatnam to the hills of Araku Valley, our Grade 8 learners stepped into an experience filled with exploration, discovery and new perspectives.

From museums and beaches to coffee plantations, caves and breathtaking viewpoints, every stop became an opportunity to observe, learn, connect and create memories together.

Four days. New places. New experiences. Countless stories to bring back home. 

Because some of the best lessons are the ones we experience.

Who says civics has to be all textbooks and notes? 

Recently, We took our 8th graders on a field trip visit to Vidhana Soudha, stepping right into the heart of Karnataka’s government! 🏛️ 

Highlighting the visit: our learners got to sit in the assembly gallery and listen to live debates on real, ongoing state issues - including intense discussions on forest conservation, law enforcement, and public accountability.

Connecting what we learn in class to what happens on the floor of the assembly makes all the difference.

Guess what happened at 11 AM? 📚

D — Drop everything. Pens, footballs, to-do lists.
E — Everyone. Grade 1 to Grade 10, teachers and staff — no exceptions.
A — And picked up a book
R — Read. Just read. Nothing else. For fifteen minutes.

That’s D.E.A.R. — Drop Everything And Read.

For fifteen minutes, our entire school paused, picked up a book, and simply read.

Because sometimes, creating a love for reading doesn’t need a lesson plan.
It just needs a few quiet minutes, a good book, and a whole school willing to pause. 📖✨

One school. One moment. Hundreds of readers.

#Airaa #airaaacademy #DropEverythingAndRead #ReadingCulture #LoveForReading  SchoolLife reading ReadingForLife
